run_get_data: run get_data to load a JSON file and extract DFT and force field values for CO2 and H2O
run_binned_average: run binned_average to compute the average prediction error within specified energy bins
run_get_Fig4a: run get_Fig4a to generate a histogram of raw force field versus DFT error for CO2 and H2O
run_phys_err: run phys_err to calculate the mean absolute error for physisorption data between 0 and -0.5 eV
run_chem_err: run chem_err to calculate the mean absolute error for chemisorption data between -0.5 and -2 eV
